title: Finite-flat norm, Kummer boundary, and degree on smooth proper curves
statement:
Let $u:X\to Y$ be a finite locally free morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-finite-locally-free], where Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $N\geq1$ be invertible on $Y$. On units define $\operatorname{Nm}_u:u_*\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ by the determinant of multiplication on the finite locally free algebra $u_*\mathcal O_X$. This gives a homomorphism $\operatorname{Nm}_u:\operatorname{Pic}(X)\to\operatorname{Pic}(Y)$, obtained by applying the unit norm to transition functions of an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Here $\operatorname{Pic}$ denotes invertible modules up to isomorphism with tensor product, and $\mathbf G_m(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times$ [def-sc-picard-group]. The two exact Kummer sequences for $X$ and $Y$ [lem-amb-kummer-any-base] form a commutative diagram, with vertical maps $\tau_{u,\mu_N}$ on $u_*\mu_{N,X}$ and $\operatorname{Nm}_u$ on both copies of $u_*\mathbf G_{m,X}$; the former is the weighted trace [lem-pur-quasifinite-flat-weighted-trace]. Use ordinary small-etale cohomology $H^q$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Writing $c_{1,N}$ for the Kummer boundary, the induced cohomology transfer satisfies
$$H^2(\tau_u)\bigl(c_{1,N}(L)\bigr)=c_{1,N}(\operatorname{Nm}_u L)$$
for every line bundle $L$ on $X$, with $H^2(X,\mu_N)=H^2(Y,u_*\mu_N)$ under finite direct image [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact]. If $X$ and $Y$ are smooth proper connected curves over an algebraically closed field $k$ and $u$ is a $k$-morphism, then $\deg_Y(\operatorname{Nm}_u L)=\deg_X(L)$ for every $L$, with degree defined by Euler-characteristic difference [def-pc-degree-line-bundle]. No separability or etaleness of $u$ is assumed.
